settingsJson.title: Settings (JSON)
settingsJson.description: The whole settings document as JSON text, in the format the options page saves with 'Save settings to a file'. When set, these settings are used as a whole and cannot be changed in the browser.

serverUrl.title: Management server address
serverUrl.description: Address of the organisation's own KYRA AI Guardrail Free management server, for example https://guardrail.example.com/. The extension downloads its settings from there. Ignored when settingsJson is set.

deviceLabel.title: Name of this browser
deviceLabel.description: The name this browser has in the management server's list, for example a PC or team name. Do not use a person's name. Optional.

serverKey.title: Enrolment key
serverKey.description: The enrolment key shown on the management server's admin page.
